_comment: M0-14: the surrogate seed-noise study behind the retrieval tolerances.
Three cells differing only in training seed, at ADR 0016's frozen full-data
configuration reduced to the established 6% subsample. Seeds are disjoint from
the gate's own seed so the anti-circularity check in tolerance_study.py accepts
the evidence; reusing the gate's seed at the gate's configuration is refused.
The subsample population is held fixed by SUBSAMPLE_SEED and does not move with
these seeds, which is the whole reason this study can mean anything.
Transfer assumption, stated because it is load-bearing: relative seed dispersion
does not increase moving from this surrogate to the full configuration.
